an8.70:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.70:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an8.70:1.3: Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:-- 2.
an8.70:1.5: yena Cāpālacetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā ti.
an8.70:1.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya Bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi. 3.
an8.70:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Cāpālacetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.70:2.2: Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:-- 4.
an8.70:3.1: Ramaṇīyā Ānanda Vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ Udenacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Gotamakacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Bahuputtakacetiyaṃ, ramanīyaṃ Sattambacetiyaṃ, ramanīyaṃ Sārandadacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Cāpālacetiyaṃ.
an8.70:3.2: Yassa kassaci Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno so Ānanda kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
an8.70:3.3: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda Tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā ti.
an8.70:3.4: Evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ,
an8.70:3.6: ‘tiṭṭhatu bhante Bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu bhante Sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan' ti, yathā taṃ Mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto. 5.
an8.70:4.2: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:-- 6.
an8.70:4.3: Ramaṇīyā Ānanda Vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ Udenacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Gotamakacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Bahuputtakacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Sattambacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Sārandadacetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Cāpālacetiyaṃ.
an8.70:4.4: Yassa kassaci Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā ākaṅkhamāno so Ānanda kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā.
an8.70:4.5: Tathāgatassa kho Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda Tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā ti.
an8.70:4.6: Evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ,
an8.70:4.8: ‘tiṭṭhatu bhante Sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan' ti, yathā taṃ Mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto. 7.
an8.70:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi
an8.70:5.2: ‘gaccha tvaṃ Ānanda, yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasī' ti.
an8.70:5.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā Bhagavato avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi. 8.
an8.70:5.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante Ānande Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.70:6.1: ‘parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu Sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato,
an8.70:6.2: bhāsitā kho pan' esā bhante Bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:6.3: ((na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī)) ti.
an8.70:6.4: Etarahi bhante bhikkhū Bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
an8.70:7.1: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu Sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato,
an8.70:7.2: bhāsitā kho pan' esā bhante Bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:7.3: ((na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti . . .
an8.70:7.4: yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti . . .
an8.70:7.5: yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññāpessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī)) ti.
an8.70:7.6: Etarahi bhante upāsikā Bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññāpenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
an8.70:8.1: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu Sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato,
an8.70:8.2: bhāsitā kho pan' esā bhante Bhagavatā vācā
an8.70:8.3: ((na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañ c' eva bhavissati phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan)) ti.
an8.70:8.4: Etarahi bhante Bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ c' eva phītañ ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
an8.70:9.1: Parinibbātu dāni bhante Bhagavā parinibbātu Sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante Bhagavato' ti.
an8.70:9.2: ‘Appossukko tvaṃ pāpima hohi, na ciraṃ Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati,
an8.70:9.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena Tathāgato parinibbāyissatī' ti. 9.
an8.70:10.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Cāpālacetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji.
an8.70:10.2: Ossaṭṭhe Bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
an8.70:10.3: Atha kho Bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.
an8.70:11.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi
an8.70:12.3: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu;
an8.70:12.4: ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā' ti?
an8.70:13.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.70:13.3: sumahā vatāyaṃ bhante bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu;
an8.70:13.4: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā' ti? 11.
an8.70:14.1: Aṭṭh' ime Ānanda hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:14.3: Yaṃ Ānanda mahāpaṭhavī udake patiṭṭhitā, udakaṃ vāte patiṭṭhitaṃ, vāto ākāsaṭṭho hoti: so Ānanda samayo, yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti, mahāvātā vāyantā udakaṃ kampenti, udakaṃ kampitaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti.
an8.70:14.4: Ayaṃ Ānanda paṭhamo hetu paṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 13.
an8.70:15.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā iddhimā cetovasippatto, devatā mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā; tassa parittā paṭhavīsaññā bhāvitā hoti appamāṇā āposaññā: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ kampeti saṃkampeti sampakampeti.
an8.70:15.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda dutiyo hetu dutiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 14.
an8.70:16.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā bodhisatto Tusitākāya cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:16.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda tatiyo hetu tatiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 15.
an8.70:17.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātukucchismā nikkhamati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:17.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda catuttho hetu catuttho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 16.
an8.70:18.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:18.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda pañcamo hetu pañcamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 17.
an8.70:19.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā Tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:19.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda chaṭṭho hetu chaṭṭho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 18.
an8.70:20.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā Tathāgato sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:20.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda sattamo hetu sattamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. 19.
an8.70:21.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda yadā Tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, tadāyaṃ paṭhavī kampati saṃkampati sampakampati.
an8.70:21.2: Ayaṃ Ānanda aṭṭhamo hetu aṭṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
an8.70:21.3: Ime kho Ānanda aṭṭha hetū aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā ti.
